mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.perm_code FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id AND r.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND r.is_deleted = 0 -- 关联 角色-权限 中间表 INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON r.id = rp.role_id AND rp.is_deleted = 0 -- 关联 权限字典表 INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON rp.permission_id = p.id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND ur.is_deleted = 0 AND p.perm_code IS NOT NULL AND p.perm_code != ''
